name: Ghoul
source: Pathfinder Monster Core, Ghoul (pg. 162), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=419
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Monster Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: For a living creature. Increase its level by 1; AC, attacks, DCs, saves, Perception and skills by 1; Strike damage by 1. Becomes an unholy undead ghoul: darkvision, void healing, immunities, Stench, burrow 5 feet, claws and jaws, Consume Flesh, Ghoul Whispers, Grave Knowledge and Swift Leap.
optional: Damage: only its Strikes deal 1 more; add 1 to its other offensive abilities (2 for limited ones) by hand. It loses abilities that come from being a living creature, and traits of its life other than human, humanoid and the ancestries (removed here): remove those by hand, and adjust abilities that conflict with its theme. Unholy: ghouls usually are; remove it if not.

choices.label: Body
choices.note: Claws if it had hands; jaws if it had a mouth.

abilities.name: Grave Knowledge
abilities.description: Frequency once per hour; Effect {Name} calls upon knowledge it retains from one creature it has consumed in the past 7 days. It attempts a skill check using a skill in which the consumed creature was trained (if it's unclear whether the creature was trained, the GM decides), as trained with a {skill:high} modifier. This takes the same amount of actions or time as usual for the check. {Name} can instead automatically learn something specific known by a creature it consumed in the last 7 days, like the location of a hidden treasure or the name of a loved one. It can do this only once for a given creature, no matter how much of its flesh it consumed.

abilities.name: Stench
abilities.description: 10 feet. A creature entering the aura or starting its turn in the area must succeed at a DC {spelldc:moderate} Fortitude save or become sickened 1 (plus slowed 1 as long as it's sickened on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save or recovers from being sickened is temporarily immune to all stench auras for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Consume Flesh
abilities.description: Requirements {Name} is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour; Effect {Name} devours a chunk of the corpse and regains {=1 + max(0, level) / 2}d6 Hit Points. It can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

abilities.name: Ghoul Whispers
abilities.description: Requirements A grabbed, paralyzed, restrained, or unconscious creature is within {name}'s reach; Effect {Name} whispers dark thoughts and vile cravings into the creature's ears. The creature must save against forbidden cravings.

abilities.name: Forbidden Cravings
abilities.description: A creature can still eat and drink while sickened by this curse. Saving Throw DC {spelldc:high} Will; Stage 1 carrier with no ill effects (1 day); Stage 2 2d6 void damage and the target is sickened 1 until it consumes raw meat (1 day); Stage 3 as stage 2; Stage 4 as stage 2 unless the target has consumed raw meat in the past 24 hours, then it takes 4d6 void damage and is sickened 2 until it consumes raw meat; Stage 5 if the creature has eaten raw meat in the past 24 hours, it dies and rises as a ghoul, if not, it returns to stage 4

abilities.name: Swift Leap
abilities.description: {Name} jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
